scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.start: concurrently "cd server && node server.js" "npx wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cd artifacts/aman-app && pnpm run dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 --strictPort false"
